title: camellia × intermedia
intro: Camellia × intermedia, commonly known as Tung oil tree, is a hybrid species of camellia that combines the Camellia oleifera and Camellia formosana plants. It is valued for its seeds, which are used to produce tung oil, a valuable resource in traditional Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Camellia × intermedia include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and polyphenols, which exhibit therapeutic actions including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antitumor activities.
